summary.title: Google-Wide Profiling: A Continuous Profiling Infrastructure for Data Centers
summary.one_liner: Google-Wide Profiling (GWP) is a continuous, low-overhead profiling system for data centers that yields fleet-wide performance profiles and novel analyses such as application-platform affinity.
takeaways: GWP is a continuous profiling infrastructure that runs across Google's data centers with negligible overhead.
It produces stable, accurate profiles usable for traditional performance analyses at datacenter scale.
GWP enables application-platform affinity measurements, showing how applications map to hardware platforms.
It can identify platform-specific microarchitectural peculiarities.
summary.summary: The page is a short abstract for the Google-Wide Profiling (GWP) paper on research.google. It describes GWP as a continuous profiling infrastructure for data centers that gives cloud application performance insights with negligible overhead. The abstract highlights stable, accurate profiles suitable for datacenter-scale traditional analyses, plus newer uses such as application-platform affinity and finding platform-specific microarchitectural quirks. The page text does not include the full method or results.
